description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh:
HPC集群ID。
取值可以由多个HPC集群ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The IDs of HPC clusters. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 HPC cluster IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
HPC集群列表的页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
description.en:
The page number of the HPC cluster list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100

默认值：10
description.en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
